interface.name: zcosmic_static_background_effect_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface allows a client to request static (cached) background effects on its surfaces, which compute the effect once and reuse the result across frames.

request.name: get_static_effect

description.summary: get a static effect object for a surface

request.description: Create a new static background effect object for the given surface.

interface.name: zcosmic_static_background_effect_v1

description.summary: static background effect for a surface

interface.description: This interface allows a client to specify regions of its surface that should have a static cached blur effect applied behind them.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the static effect object. The static effect state for the surface will be removed on the next commit.

request.name: set_blur_region
request.description:
Set the region of the surface where the background should be blurred using a static cached blur.
Passing null means that the blur effect is removed.
